whatIsMeiHao.question: What is MeiHao?
whatIsMeiHao.answer: MeiHao is an AI-powered intelligent video creation platform that enables everyone to easily create professional-level video content. From concept to finished product, it's all done with one click.

howToStart.question: How do I get started with MeiHao?
howToStart.answer: After registering an account, choose a subscription plan that suits you and start creating. The platform provides an intuitive interface, so even beginners can get started quickly.

supportedFormats.question: What video formats and types are supported?
supportedFormats.answer: MeiHao supports Hollywood films, anime, story plots, advertisements, educational videos, and more — all exported in industry-standard formats.

videoQuality.question: How is video quality ensured?
videoQuality.answer: We use advanced AI algorithms and professional rendering engines to ensure output quality. All videos undergo quality review to ensure professional standards.

pricingPlans.question: What pricing plans are available?
pricingPlans.answer: We offer Trial, Pro, and Annual plans. Trial is a one-time purchase valid for 7 days; Pro and Annual are subscription plans that automatically renew and charge when they expire, and can be cancelled anytime. Trial can only be purchased once — after purchase, it cannot be bought again.

technicalSupport.question: Is technical support provided?
technicalSupport.answer: Yes, we provide 24/7 technical support. Pro and Annual users enjoy priority technical support.
